mapper.select: SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS TEXT), true)
SELECT id, display_name AS displayName, tenant_status AS status, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tenants WHERE id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actorIdentityId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM password_setup_delivery_work_items WHERE password_setup_delivery_work_items.workflow_id = tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows.workflow_id AND work_status = 'PENDING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows (workflow_id, tenant_id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, administrator_email, administrator_display_name, identity_request_id, consume_operation_id, release_operation_id, password_delivery_request_id, trace_id, outcome_code, response_status, response_body, created_at, completed_at, expires_at, workflow_state, attempt_count, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{row.workflowId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.actorIdentityId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.administratorEmail}, #{row.administratorDisplayName}, #{row.identityRequestId}, #{row.consumeOperationId}, #{row.releaseOperationId}, #{row.passwordDeliveryRequestId}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.outcomeCode}, #{row.responseStatus}, CAST(#{row.responseBody} AS JSONB), #{row.createdAt}, #{row.completedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.workflowState}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.nextAttemptAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT workflow_id AS workflowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, actor_identity_id AS actorIdentityId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, administrator_email AS administratorEmail, administrator_display_name AS administratorDisplayName, identity_request_id AS identityRequestId, consume_operation_id AS consumeOperationId, release_operation_id AS releaseOperationId, password_delivery_request_id AS passwordDeliveryRequestId, trace_id AS traceId, outcome_code AS outcomeCode, response_status AS responseStatus, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody, created_at AS createdAt, completed_at AS completedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, workflow_state AS workflowState, administrator_identity_id AS administratorIdentityId, credential_disposition AS credentialDisposition, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, lease_owner AS leaseOwner, lease_until AS leaseUntil, recovery_exhausted_at AS recoveryExhaustedAt, last_failure AS lastFailure, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM password_setup_delivery_work_items work WHERE work.workflow_id = tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows.workflow_id AND work.work_status = 'PENDING') AS passwordDeliveryPending FROM tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actorIdentityId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT workflow_id AS workflowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, actor_identity_id AS actorIdentityId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, administrator_email AS administratorEmail, administrator_display_name AS administratorDisplayName, identity_request_id AS identityRequestId, consume_operation_id AS consumeOperationId, release_operation_id AS releaseOperationId, password_delivery_request_id AS passwordDeliveryRequestId, trace_id AS traceId, outcome_code AS outcomeCode, response_status AS responseStatus, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody, created_at AS createdAt, completed_at AS completedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, workflow_state AS workflowState, administrator_identity_id AS administratorIdentityId, credential_disposition AS credentialDisposition, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, lease_owner AS leaseOwner, lease_until AS leaseUntil, recovery_exhausted_at AS recoveryExhaustedAt, last_failure AS lastFailure, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM password_setup_delivery_work_items work WHERE work.workflow_id = tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows.workflow_id AND work.work_status = 'PENDING') AS passwordDeliveryPending FROM tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows SET workflow_state = 'IDENTITY_READY', administrator_identity_id = #{administratorIdentityId}, credential_disposition = #{credentialDisposition}, next_attempt_at = #{completedAt}, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND workflow_state = 'PREPARED' AND lease_owner = #{claimant} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}

UPDATE tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows SET workflow_state = 'FAILED', outcome_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN_INITIALIZATION_RETRY_REQUIRED', response_status = 409, completed_at = #{completedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND workflow_state = 'COMPENSATING' AND lease_owner = #{claimant} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}

UPDATE tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows SET workflow_state = 'FAILED', outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, response_status = #{responseStatus}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND outcome_code IS NULL AND lease_owner = #{claimant} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memberships (id, tenant_id, identity_id, membership_status) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{tenantId}, #{identityId}, 'ENABLED') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, identity_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM memberships WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND identity_id = #{identityId}
mapper.update: UPDATE memberships SET membership_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE id = #{membershipId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_roles (id, tenant_id, role_key, system_managed, created_at) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR', true, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, role_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tenant_roles WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_key = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' AND system_managed = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_role_assignments (tenant_id, membership_id, role_id, assigned_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{roleId}, #{assignedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO initial_tenant_administrators (tenant_id, membership_id, established_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{establishedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT membership_id FROM initial_tenant_administrators WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_setup_delivery_work_items (workflow_id, tenant_id, identity_id, delivery_request_id, work_status, created_at) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{tenantId}, #{identityId}, #{deliveryRequestId}, 'PENDING', #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (workflow_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows SET workflow_state = 'SUCCEEDED', outcome_code = 'SUCCESS', response_status = 200, response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS JSONB), completed_at = #{completedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, lease_owner = CASE WHEN #{releaseLease} THEN NULL ELSE lease_owner END, lease_until = CASE WHEN #{releaseLease} THEN NULL ELSE lease_until END, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND workflow_state = 'ACTIVATING' AND outcome_code IS NULL AND lease_owner = #{claimant} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}

WITH completed AS ( UPDATE password_setup_delivery_work_items SET work_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND work_status = 'PENDING' RETURNING workflow_id ) UPDATE tenant_administrator_initialization_workflows workflow SET lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL FROM completed WHERE workflow.workflow_id = completed.workflow_id AND workflow.lease_owner = #{claimant} AND workflow.attempt_count = #{attemptCount}
